title: console UX conventions (family card): inline-edit Save All and Studio Discard draft give no feedback, and Studio's read-only Field properties controls are disabled with no reason and no keyboard path to one

**Reader who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat. A **family card**: one row per location, each independently fixable and checkable; later rows of the same family go here as comments. **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "inline edit Save All no success feedback toast discard draft no confirmation disabled control no reason tooltip keyboard Studio field properties" — 31 hits, no open card covers these rows (nearest, all closed: objectui#11807 publish confirmation, objectui#11784 package discard, objectui#11781 read-only inspector wording).

## Environment

objectstack `36b2889c` with the console built from objectui `1fb1ced36243` (the pin hop of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104, since landed as `f451a5964`), stock `examples/app-showcase`, admin persona (and a member where noted). Every row reproduced at least twice on fresh loads by the runner; none is a regression of the pin hop (no hop commit touches the files named).

## Rows

| # | Location (objectui `1fb1ced36243`) | Reproduction | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` `defaultBatchSave` / `defaultRowSave` (persist, then `setRefreshKey` only) | Tasks grid view, inline edit on → change a row's Priority → "Save All (1)". `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID` 200 and the value lands, but no toast, `role=status` or `role=alert` text appears within 3 s; the dirty bar just disappears (admin ×2, member ×1). Every other write surface measured in the same pass gives feedback (create, bulk delete, Mark Done, invite, import, Studio autosave/publish, settings). | Visible success feedback naming the change. |
| 2 | `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` `doDiscardDraft` (resets state, no toast) | A scratch-package object with a pending draft → `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/object/OBJECT` → "Discard draft" → accept the confirm. `DELETE …?state=draft` 200 "Draft discarded — object/…", the banner goes, and nothing says so. | A visible confirmation naming what was discarded. |
| 3 | `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` Field properties rail on a read-only package | `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/data?surface=object:showcase_task` → Form → select field Priority → the rail's API name / Label / Type / Required / Unique / Description / Default value inputs and the Remove button are disabled with `title` null, no `aria-describedby`, no adjacent note (the only "Read-only" text is the header badge and a canvas line). | A reason on hover AND on focus — the Archive pattern (a focusable wrapper carrying `aria-describedby`, "Not available for this record") already passes on the record page. |
| 4 | Studio header Publish and the automation enable toggle on a read-only package | Their reason is a `title` on a disabled `button` with no focusable wrapper: Tab from "Changes" skips Publish entirely, so the reason ("Read-only package — switch to or create a writable package to edit.") is unreachable by keyboard or assistive tech. | The reason reachable in the tab order. |
| 5 | Record import wizard, disabled "Next" | Upload a CSV with no `project` column: the visible "Can't continue — required field(s) not mapped: Project (project)…" text is not associated with the disabled, non-focusable Next (no `aria-describedby`, no `title`). | The reason associated with the control. |
